 Game of the Week: Men’s basketball vs Texas Southern
 Jimin Han , Staff Writer 
 • 
 Nov 16, 2026 
 Photo by Vishva Parmar / UCSD Guardian 
 Date: Monday, Nov. 16, 7 p.m.
Location: LionTree Arena
 UC San Diego men’s basketball (2-1, 0-0 Big West) will face Texas Southern (1-3, 0-0 SWAC) at LionTree Arena on Monday, Nov. 16, in celebration of Military Appreciation Night.
 The Tritons have opened their season strong, with back-to-back wins against Whittier College and Fresno State. Transfer senior guard Rahmir Barno has proved to be a fundamental addition to the Tritons’ roster, shooting a staggering 58.3% from the field and getting efficient looks at the rim. As the Tritons continue to adjust their offense and build momentum, the matchup could pit this hot-start engine against a defense-minded opponent.
 The match could also feature the Tritons’ shooting threats within the clutch. The Tritons have dominated the second half in recent matchups, shooting an astounding 50% from 3-point range. The Tritons’ shooting jump could present key swings throughout the high-tension game.
 As the Tritons approach Big West play next month, they hope to refine their offensive play style and establish themselves as formidable contenders among the conference.
